description: Each fixture names the definition of ../../schemas/host-operations.schema.json it is checked against and whether it is valid. The Host reads every answer fixture as it reads an answer of a Plugin API Level 2 Plugin: it accepts the valid ones and refuses the invalid ones as protocol violations.

fixtures.note: Emoji answers Return: a view that shows the insertion target, its state, and one insertion that closes the view on success
An Action without a view requests one insertion: a valid shape, which the Host refuses at execution with target_not_shown because nothing showed a target
An insertion with a toast and a request to be told the outcome
Emoji's insertion asks to hear its outcome and to close the view on success: Level 2 delivers the outcome after the view closed
A bare string stands for the primary member: clipboard.write copies only once the answer is accepted
open.url requested after a gesture, its link http or https
host.showPluginSettings takes no input
Every Level 1 answer stays valid for a Level 2 script
null still means nothing to show
close cannot carry an operation; use closes_view so a refusal keeps the view
At most one operation per answer: operations is not a member
host.confirm is reserved: no Level requests it yet
A request names the catalogue ID, selection.replace, not Level 1's insert_text
selection.readText returns data, which only a script's call can use
selection.replace needs its input
A Plugin cannot choose the App; the Host resolves it
host.showPluginSettings opens a sheet beside the view and takes no closes_view
id is at most 64 characters
id is not blank
Success carries no reason
The App in front was not the one the Host showed; the reason names no App
A request without an id is reported without operation
The owner ended before the operation ran
Delivered after the view closed, to a viewless invocation of the requesting Action
A refusal reached after the view closed still says why
view_closed is present only when the view closed, as true
An operation cancelled before it ran is never delivered after its view closed
Level 1 events are unchanged
A refusal says why
Only refused and failed carry a reason
The target's identity is Host data and never reaches the Plugin
Reasons come from the published list
Keyboard-event insertion cannot tell whether the App took the text, so text_rejected is not a reason at Level 2
Current App asks to quit the App in front gracefully, which needs no Host Confirmation, and to hear the outcome (#83)
Force Quit of the App an App Target from apps.frontmost names, with a toast; the Host asks a Host Confirmation naming it (#83)
apps.quit takes no process ID or any member but target and force: there is no kill by process
A target is an App Target apps.frontmost gave, never a word such as frontmost
force is true or false
Close the front window of the App an App Target names, as its own ⌘W does; the Host asks a Host Confirmation naming it when that App is not in front (#83)
apps.close takes only a target: there is no forced close
The App offers no Quit: its own menu has no enabled ⌘Q item, as Finder has none; nothing was done and the App is not named
Close and Quit press the App's own menu items through Accessibility, which Spinnet lacks; Force Quit does not need it
The user declined the Host Confirmation of a Force Quit, or of a close or quit of an App not in front
declined is never delivered after the view closed: closing the view cancels a Host Confirmation in it
